class8.subtitle: Official NCERT Textbook Chapter-by-Chapter PDFs (Parts I & II) • NEP 2020

chapters.title: A Square and A Cube
chapters.desc: Exploration of square numbers, square roots, prime factorisation patterns, cube numbers, cube roots, and geometric visualizations.

chapters.title: Power Play
chapters.desc: Exponents and powers with negative exponents, laws of indices (aᵐ × aⁿ = aᵐ⁺ⁿ, aᵐ / aⁿ = aᵐ⁻ⁿ), and standard scientific notation.

chapters.title: A Story of Numbers
chapters.desc: Generalised form of numbers, reversible digit patterns, palindromic numbers, and historical perspectives on Indian mathematics.

chapters.title: Quadrilaterals
chapters.desc: Classification of polygons, angle sum property, exterior angle theorem, and special properties of parallelograms, rhombuses, and squares.

chapters.title: Number Play
chapters.desc: Letters for digits (cryptarithms), magic squares, divisibility tests for 2, 3, 5, 9, 10, and 11, and recreational mathematical logic.

chapters.title: We Distribute, Yet Things Multiply
chapters.desc: Distributive law, multiplication of monomials, binomials, and polynomials, and visual geometric models for (a + b)² and (a − b)².

chapters.title: Proportional Reasoning-1
chapters.desc: Direct and inverse proportions, constant of proportionality (k = y/x and xy = k), speed-distance-time, and unitary method.

chapters.title: Fractions in Disguise (Percentages)
chapters.desc: Percentages as ratios and fractions, percentage change, profit & loss, discount, GST calculations, and comparing quantities.

chapters.title: The Baudhayana-Pythagoras Theorem
chapters.desc: Historical origins in Baudhayana Sulba-Sutra (a² + b² = c²), geometric dissection proofs, Pythagorean triplets, and distances.

chapters.title: Proportional Reasoning-2
chapters.desc: Compound interest deduced by repeated simple interest, compounding formulas, population growth, and depreciation models.

chapters.title: Exploring Some Geometric Themes
chapters.desc: Faces, edges, vertices of 3D solids, Euler's formula (V − E + F = 2), nets for polyhedra, symmetry planes, and intro to fractals.

chapters.title: Tales by Dots and Lines
chapters.desc: Data handling, constructing and reading line graphs, histograms, central tendency (mean, median, mode), and trend analytics.

chapters.title: Algebra Play
chapters.desc: Linear equations in one variable, transposing terms, balancing method, equations reducible to linear form, and word problems.

chapters.title: Area
chapters.desc: Area of trapezium, rhombus, special quadrilaterals, general polygons by triangulation, composite 2D shapes, and field surveys.

class9.subtitle: Official NCERT Textbook Chapter-by-Chapter PDFs (Part 1 & Part 2) • NEP 2020

chapters.title: Orienting Yourself: The Use of Coordinates
chapters.desc: Cartesian plane, coordinate axes, plotting points with given coordinates, quadrant signs, and geometric position mapping.

chapters.title: Introduction to Linear Polynomials
chapters.desc: Definition of polynomials, degree of a polynomial, zeros of linear polynomials, and geometric representation of roots.

chapters.title: The World of Numbers
chapters.desc: Irrational numbers (√2, √3, π), real number continuum, visualizing numbers on the number line using magnification, and surds.

chapters.title: Exploring Algebraic Identities
chapters.desc: Quadratic and cubic identities: (x + y + z)², (x ± y)³, x³ + y³ + z³ − 3xyz, factor theorem, and splitting middle terms.

chapters.title: I'm Up and Down, and Round and Round
chapters.desc: Circles and symmetry, perpendicular from center to a chord, equal chords, angle subtended by an arc at the center, and cyclic quads.

chapters.title: Measuring Space: Perimeter and Area
chapters.desc: Heron's formula √[s(s − a)(s − b)(s − c)], area of scalene, isosceles, and equilateral triangles, and area of irregular plots.

chapters.title: The Mathematics of Maybe: Introduction to Probability
chapters.desc: Empirical and experimental probability, trials, events, relative frequencies, coin-toss & dice experiments, and game odds.

chapters.title: Predicting What Comes Next: Exploring Sequences
chapters.desc: Number patterns, sequence rules, first difference & second difference tables, arithmetic progression foundations, and general n-th terms.

chapters.title: Propositions and Converses
chapters.desc: Logical reasoning, axioms and postulates, parallel lines & transversal theorems, and triangle congruence (SAS, ASA, SSS, RHS).

chapters.title: How Quantities Combine: Understanding Data
chapters.desc: Weighted averages, grouped and ungrouped frequency distributions, histograms with varying base widths, frequency polygons, and analytics.

chapters.title: The World of Algorithms
chapters.desc: Euclid's division algorithm for GCD, flowcharts, step-by-step computational thinking, iteration, and discrete problem-solving.

chapters.title: Quadrilaterals
chapters.desc: Properties of parallelograms, diagonal bisectors, the Mid-point Theorem and converse, tessellations, and regular polygon tilings.

chapters.title: Two Variables, One Line
chapters.desc: Linear equations in two variables (ax + by + c = 0), integer solutions, plotting line graphs, lines parallel to axes, and rate curves.

chapters.title: Math of Space: Surface Area and Volume
chapters.desc: Surface areas and volumes of right circular cones, spheres, hemispheres, composite 3D objects, and practical solid conversions.
chapters.pdf: assets/pdfs/books/chapter-wise/class-9/ch-14/ch-14 Math of Space Surface Area and Volume.pdf

class10.subtitle: Official Complete NCERT Textbook Chapter-by-Chapter PDFs • CBSE 2026-27

chapters.title: Real Numbers
chapters.desc: Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic, prime factorisation method for HCF & LCM, and proofs of irrationality of √2, √3, √5.

chapters.title: Polynomials
chapters.desc: Geometrical meaning of zeros, relationship between zeros and coefficients of quadratic polynomials, and polynomial formation.

chapters.title: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables
chapters.desc: Graphical method of solution, consistency/inconsistency conditions, algebraic methods (Substitution & Elimination), and word problems.

chapters.title: Quadratic Equations
chapters.desc: Standard form ax² + bx + c = 0, solution by factorisation and quadratic formula, and nature of roots via discriminant (b² − 4ac).

chapters.title: Arithmetic Progressions
chapters.desc: Derivation of n-th term an = a + (n−1)d, sum of first n terms (Sₙ), and practical application word problems & case studies.

chapters.title: Triangles
chapters.desc: Basic Proportionality Theorem (Thales Theorem & converse), criteria for similarity of triangles (AAA, SSS, SAS), and geometric proofs.

chapters.title: Coordinate Geometry
chapters.desc: Distance formula √[(x₂−x₁)² + (y₂−y₁)²], section formula (internal division), midpoint formula, and collinearity verification.

chapters.title: Introduction to Trigonometry
chapters.desc: Trigonometric ratios of acute angles, values at 0°, 30°, 45°, 60°, 90°, and proofs of fundamental identities (sin²θ + cos²θ = 1).

chapters.title: Some Applications of Trigonometry
chapters.desc: Heights and distances, line of sight, angle of elevation, angle of depression, and multi-triangle geometric case problems.

chapters.title: Circles
chapters.desc: Tangent to a circle, theorem that tangents from an external point are equal in length, and radius-tangent perpendicularity proofs.

chapters.title: Areas Related to Circles
chapters.desc: Area of sector and segment of a circle, arc length formula, and areas of composite geometric plane figures.

chapters.title: Surface Areas and Volumes
chapters.desc: Surface areas and volumes of combinations of cubes, cuboids, spheres, hemispheres, and cylinders, plus shape reshaping.

chapters.title: Statistics
chapters.desc: Mean, median, and mode of grouped data, mean by direct and assumed mean methods, and modal value determination.

chapters.title: Probability
chapters.desc: Classical definition of probability, simple problems on single events, complementary events P(E) + P(not E) = 1.

class11.subtitle: Official Complete NCERT Textbook Chapter-by-Chapter PDFs • CBSE 2026-27

chapters.title: Sets
chapters.desc: Roster & set-builder forms, empty set, subsets, power sets, universal sets, Venn diagrams, union and intersection laws, De Morgan's laws.

chapters.title: Relations and Functions
chapters.desc: Ordered pairs, Cartesian product A × B, relations, definition of function, domain, codomain, range, graphs of standard functions.

chapters.title: Trigonometric Functions
chapters.desc: Positive and negative angles, radian measure, unit circle definitions, signs in four quadrants, and compound & multiple angle formulas.

chapters.title: Complex Numbers & Quadratic Equations
chapters.desc: Algebra of complex numbers (a + ib), conjugate, modulus, Argand plane representation, and quadratic equations with negative discriminant in ℂ.

chapters.title: Linear Inequalities
chapters.desc: Algebraic solutions of linear inequalities in one variable, number line representation, and graphical solution of systems of inequalities in two variables.

chapters.title: Permutations and Combinations
chapters.desc: Fundamental principle of counting, factorial n!, permutations (ⁿPᵣ), circular permutations, combinations (ⁿCᵣ), and restricted selections.

chapters.title: Binomial Theorem
chapters.desc: History and statement of Binomial Theorem for positive integral indices, Pascal's triangle, expansion of (a + b)ⁿ, and approximations.

chapters.title: Sequences and Series
chapters.desc: Arithmetic Progression review, Geometric Progression (G.P.), general term arⁿ⁻¹, sum of n terms (Sₙ), infinite G.P., and A.M.–G.M. relation.

chapters.title: Straight Lines
chapters.desc: Slope (m = tan θ), angle between lines, slope-intercept, point-slope, two-point, intercept, and normal forms, distance of point from line.

chapters.title: Conic Sections
chapters.desc: Sections of a cone, Circle, Parabola (y² = 4ax), Ellipse (x²/a² + y²/b² = 1), Hyperbola, eccentricity e, and latus rectum.

chapters.title: Three Dimensional Geometry
chapters.desc: Coordinate axes and planes in 3D, coordinates of a point, distance between two spatial points √[(x₂−x₁)² + (y₂−y₁)² + (z₂−z₁)²], and section formula.

chapters.title: Limits and Derivatives
chapters.desc: Intuitive limit concept, left/right limits, standard limit lim [sin(x)/x] = 1, derivative as rate of change, and first principle derivative method.

chapters.title: Statistics
chapters.desc: Measures of dispersion: range, mean deviation about mean, mean deviation about median for grouped data, variance (σ²), and standard deviation (σ).

chapters.title: Probability
chapters.desc: Random experiments, sample space, events, axiomatic approach to probability, addition theorem P(A ∪ B) = P(A) + P(B) − P(A ∩ B).

class12.subtitle: Official Complete NCERT Textbook Chapter-by-Chapter PDFs (Part 1 & Part 2) • CBSE 2026-27

chapters.title: Relations and Functions
chapters.desc: Types of relations: reflexive, symmetric, transitive and equivalence. One-to-one and onto functions, composite functions, and invertibility.

chapters.title: Inverse Trigonometric Functions
chapters.desc: Definition, range, domain, principal value branches, graphs of inverse trigonometric functions, and evaluation of multi-angle expressions.

chapters.title: Matrices
chapters.desc: Concept, notation, order, equality, types of matrices, transpose of a matrix, symmetric and skew-symmetric matrices, and matrix multiplication.

chapters.title: Determinants
chapters.desc: Determinant of square matrices up to 3x3, minors, cofactors, adjoint and inverse of a matrix, and solving systems of linear equations.

chapters.title: Continuity and Differentiability
chapters.desc: Continuity at points, derivative of composite functions (Chain Rule), derivative of implicit functions, logarithmic differentiation, and second-order derivatives.

chapters.title: Applications of Derivatives (AOD)
chapters.desc: Rate of change of quantities, strictly increasing/decreasing functions, tangents/normals, and maxima & minima applied to geometric optimization.

chapters.title: Integrals
chapters.desc: Integration by substitution, partial fractions, integration by parts, fundamental theorem of calculus, and definite integral properties.

chapters.title: Applications of Integrals (AOI)
chapters.desc: Area under simple curves: circles, parabolas, ellipses in standard form, and finding areas bounded by curves and intersecting straight lines.

chapters.title: Differential Equations
chapters.desc: Order and degree, general and particular solutions, formation of differential equations, variable separable, homogeneous, and linear equations.

chapters.title: Vector Algebra
chapters.desc: Vectors and scalars, magnitude and direction, direction cosines/ratios, types of vectors, position vector, dot product, cross product, and projections.

chapters.title: Three Dimensional Geometry
chapters.desc: Direction cosines and direction ratios of a line, vector and Cartesian equation of a line, coplanar and skew lines, and shortest distance.

chapters.title: Linear Programming (LPP)
chapters.desc: Introduction, terminology: constraints, objective function, optimization, mathematical formulation of LPP, and corner point graphical method.

chapters.title: Probability
chapters.desc: Conditional probability, multiplication theorem, independent events, total probability theorem, Bayes' theorem, and probability distributions.
